author: PC Gamer
text:
Saudi Arabia's $55 billion takeover of Electronic Arts will happen next week
EA says all regulatory hurdles are cleared, so all that's left to do is to do it.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Xbox revenues dipped $1.7 billion last year, but Asha Sharma predicts a 'return to growth' by mid-2027
The numbers are big and impressive, but the main message appears to be that Xbox isn't going anywhere.

author: PC Gamer
text:
There's a timeline where Dark Souls was a PlayStation exclusive, but Sony lost out on the chance because it wouldn't publish Demon's Souls in North America
Things could always be worse.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Godot natively supports coding in Sumero-Akkadian Cuneiform, if you needed another reason to switch game engines
Take cognizance that (from now on) I will not accept here any code that is not of fine quality.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Has 'Xbox 360 brown' nostalgia finally arrived?
Mid-2000s grittiness may be due a comeback.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Valve finally gives Deadlock a proper ranked mode, warns that matches will be 'very rocky' to start
Yoshi has delivered.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Blizzard is keeping secrets about Diablo 4's next season until BlizzCon, but you can still try some of it out next week
There are still plenty of new toys to play with though.

author: PC Gamer
text:
This upcoming Steam game is pioneering the accursed trucking genre, and as a former delivery guy I could not be more thrilled
Prospice: Anomalous Logistics simulates the canonical deliveryman experience of having your dreambody dissolved in the labyrinth of collective death.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'A new version of Amnesia: The Dark Descent' may be coming later this year
Frictional's latest annual report spilled the beans, although it's not clear what the new version will entail.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Gears of War: E-Day devs are embracing 'old-school' multiplayer in 2026: 'No battle pass, no tour of duty, no gimmicks, no bullsh*t'
But, of course, there's a catch.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'We are not looking to just maintain' Elder Scrolls Online, new ZeniMax boss says, but a bunch of updates have been delayed into 2027 and possibly beyond
New studio co-chief Nick Giacomini says teams will have "the runway they need to do things right."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Dbrand unveils Steam Machine customization 'backup plan' after its Companion Cube got confined to the test chamber
That's a wrap.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Thimbleweed Park 2 is 'not really a sequel, not really a prequel,' but it is finally happening
Ron Gilbert says the next game in the now-a-series is set to come out in early 2028.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Meta continues to insist AI spend is totally justified, potentially blowing over $8 billion on data centers
Just because Meta keeps saying AI is paying off doesn't necessarily make it true.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Where to find Hirosaki Castle in Forza Horizon 6
Snap a photo for the Classy Castle challenge.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Where to find the Hokubu region Treasure Hunt in Forza Horizon 6
Locate the random shack in the snow.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Guillermo del Toro is asking for a slightly more forgiving Dead Cells, checkpoints and all, 'for the elderly players'
That actually sounds pretty nice, even if it defeats the point.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Meta is still flinging the equivalent of a small country's annual GDP down the Reality Labs money pit each and every quarter
Perhaps the next couple of billion will do the trick.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Old School RuneScape players are getting their boats stuck Suez Canal-style thanks to a narrow river in its new island: 'Helmp mee'
Helmp, I need somebody, helmp, not just anybody.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The memory crisis keeps getting worse: Nvidia graphics card prices now rumoured to increase by as much as 30%
And graphics card prices were already not looking pretty.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The Helldivers 2 x Warhammer 40k Warbond arrives on August 12, bringing three of its most iconic weapons and two Imperial Guard armour sets
For the Empero- I mean, "Super Earth".

author: PC Gamer
text:
Gears of War: E-Day multiplayer is so old, it feels new again
Horde and Versus without the chaff.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Roblox and ChatGPT will reportedly have to suck less thanks to the EU's Digital Services Act
Both will allegedly fall under the Very Large Online Platforms designation, which comes with stricter rules.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Gleefully counting its billions, Samsung cries warning of a 'severe' memory supply crisis next year
'Beyond 2029, it is hard to say because of more limited visibility'

author: PC Gamer
text:
Arc Raiders rats are cheating the matchmaking system by throwing themselves in front of friendly fire
Where there's a will, there's a rat.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Final Fantasy 7 remake director says he hopes Revelation will get 'some kind of physical edition' despite the industry and Sony's 'shift away' from discs
A difficult disc-ussion.

author: PC Gamer
text:
PSA: Don't execute PowerShell commands proffered by Steam forum randos, because it could infect your rig with a cryptominer
No judgment, just a friendly reminder.

author: PC Gamer
text:
BeamNG.drive just had a graphics overhaul so we can finally watch a family hatchback navigate a speedbump at 100mph with dynamic ambient lighting
The UI's had a refresh too.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Proving Doom can actually run on anything, one programmer has made a working build for Commodore 64
It doesn't necessarily look fun, but it does look like Doom running on a Commodore 64.

author: PC Gamer
text:
An innocent man spent 18 months in prison because police misread his Skyrim user name
The error came to light while lawyers were working on his appeal.
